style: Style: a real photograph taken on a phone by a friend, natural daylight, slightly imperfect framing, slight film grain, warm tone, shallow depth of field. Not polished, not a studio shoot, not a model, natural skin texture. Square 1:1 framing with the whole head and shoulders inside the frame and clear space around the head, because it will be cropped to a circle. No text, no logos, no watermark.

jobs.name: owner-cta
jobs.prompt:
Scene: behind the counter of a small Australian business, a bakery or cafe or hardware store, bright daylight through the shopfront window, shelves and products softly out of focus.
Subject: an Australian woman in her late 30s to mid 40s who owns the place, in a plain tee with an apron, hair tied back loosely.
Details: caught mid-laugh, genuinely delighted, arms crossed and resting on the counter, leaning slightly toward the camera.
Constraints: candid and joyful, not posed; ordinary business owner, not a model; head and shoulders centred with room above.
